tech.summary: Anthropic ne 19 Nov ko Nasdaq par ANT ticker se trading shuru ki — $83 IPO price se 34% upar, $111.50 par khula, aur din ke doran $2 trillion valuation ko chhoo kar duniya ki chhathi sab se bari public company ban gaya. 980 million shares $83 par bech kar $81.3bn raise kiye — America ki tareekh ki sab se bari IPO. Lekin excitement din bhar qaim na rahi — dopahar tak shares $97 par aa gaye. Anthropic ki Q3 revenue $17bn thi, aur Amazon aur Google ke saath taqreeban $900bn ki computing commitments hain.
tech.title: Anthropic ka Nasdaq debut — $111.50 par khula, $2 trillion valuation ko chhoo liya

tech.summary: Google ne 19 Nov ko Gemini app for Mac mein 'computer use' add kar diya — Gemini ab aap ki apps mein click kar sakta hai, type kar sakta hai, forms bhar sakta hai aur multi-step kaam poora kar sakta hai, woh bhi aik alag window mein taa ke aap apna kaam jaari rakh saken. Lekin muft nahi — Google AI Plus, Pro ya Ultra subscription chahiye, US aur English only, aur Apple Silicon Mac (M1 ya naya) zaroori hai. Apple bhi macOS 27.3 mein AI agents ke liye sakht permissions la raha hai.
tech.title: Gemini ab aap ka Mac bhi chala sakta hai — forms bhare, presentations banaye

tech.summary: OpenAI ne GPT-6.2 Astra aur Sol release kar diye — dono models company ke 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold par pohnchte hain, wohi level jis ki wajah se GPT-6 Cyber sirf vetted security teams ko milta tha. Ab ye capability kisi ko bhi mil sakti hai — aik aisa model jo software ki kamzoriyan dhoond aur exploit kar sakta hai. OpenAI ne badle mein 'Control Room' monitoring system lagaya hai. Astra $8 per million tokens hai, aur legal benchmark LAB-AA par Claude Fable 5.2 se dugna pass rate deta hai — aik chhathi qeemat par.
tech.title: OpenAI ne apne sab se taqatwar cyber models sab ke liye khol diye

tech.summary: Reuters ke mutabiq NVIDIA ne licensed Hopper-class AI chips — jin mein H200 bhi shamil hai — China bhejna band kar diye hain, halaan ke kuch shipments ke liye US export approvals maujood the. Masla doosri taraf hai: China ki apni import restrictions. Taqreeban 600,000 H200 chips Hong Kong mein shipment ka intezar kar rahe the. Ye AI computing supply chain ki geopolitics ka naya chapter hai — license milna ab ye guarantee nahi ke chip pohanch bhi jayega.
tech.title: NVIDIA ne China ko H200 AI chips bhejna band kar diya

tech.summary: Anthropic ke Claude Fable 5.2 ne black-hole physics ke do open problems solve kar diye — weak coupling par abrupt Hawking-Page transition, aur modular bootstrap ceiling (M₁ ≤ c/9.1266). Dono results September mein Lean mein formally verify ho chuke hain. Ye sirf benchmark score nahi — AI ne asal tehqeeq mein naya result diya hai. Isi briefing mein Gemini 4 Neon bhi tez nikla: OpenRouter par 127 tokens/sec, jabke Carbon sirf 46.
tech.title: Claude Fable 5.2 ne black-hole physics ke do khule masle hal kar diye

tech.summary: PHP 8.6 aur PostgreSQL 19 dono ek hi din release ho gaye — developers ke liye aik hi din mein do bari updates. PHP 8.6 naye features aur performance improvements le kar aaya hai, jabke PostgreSQL 19 database ki nayi capabilities. Dono open-source stack ka backbone hain — Laravel se le kar bare data systems tak, ye updates seedha production par asar dalte hain.
tech.title: PHP 8.6 aur PostgreSQL 19 ek hi din release — developers ke liye double khushi

pakistan.summary: PM Shehbaz Sharif ne American Business Council ko bataya ke civilian hukumat aur Field Marshal Asim Munir ki team ke darmiyan cooperation ne Pakistan ki economy ko sambhala hai — 'Pakistan ki tareekh mein aisi productive partnership kabhi nahi hui.' Un ke mutabiq reserves taqreeban $27bn hain, mehngai 32% se gir kar 11.5% aur policy rate 23.5% se 12% ho gaya hai. Lekin unhon ne khud mana ke recovery nazuk hai — Pakistan apni energy ka 90% se zyada import karta hai.
pakistan.title: PM Shehbaz: civil-military ittehad ne economy ko default se bachaya

pakistan.summary: Senate Standing Committee on Finance ne Karachi Chamber mein mulk ki girti exports par tashweesh zahir ki — Senator Talha Mahmood ke mutabiq exports pichle saal $30bn se gir kar $28bn ho gayi hain. Unhon ne taxation aur trade policies par nazr-e-sani ka mutalba kiya, aur Turkiye se mawazna kiya jis ki exports $250bn se zyada hain. Committee ne FBR ke 'faceless' tax assessment system par bhi tanqeed ki — training diye baghair implement kar diya gaya.
pakistan.title: Senators pareshan: exports $30bn se gir kar $28bn — reforms ka mutalba

pakistan.summary: Deputy PM aur Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar ne ASEAN Secretary-General Dr Kao Kim Hourn se mulaqat mein trade, technology, taleem, climate action aur food security mein taawun barhane par ittefaq kiya. Dono taraf ne business delegations ke tabadle aur chambers ke darmiyan mazboot rabte par bhi zor diya. Dar ne kaha ke Pakistan digital economy aur emerging technologies mein ASEAN ke saath kaam karne ka khwahishmand hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan aur ASEAN ne trade, security aur technology mein taawun barhane par ittefaq kar liya

pakistan.summary: Rawalpindi Test ke teesre din Sri Lanka ne neeche ke batsmen ki madad se 309-9 bana kar match chauthe din tak khinch liya — ab un ki bartari 82 runs hai, Milan Rathnayaka 60 par not out. Pakistan ne pehli innings mein 227 runs ki bartari li thi (Sri Lanka 98 all out, Pakistan 325). Aamer Jamal ne 3 wickets liye (67 runs de kar), jabke Abbas aur Razaullah ne 2-2. Saqib Khan hamstring strain ki wajah se din bhar bahar rahe.
pakistan.title: Sri Lanka ki larai ke bawajood Pakistan jeet ke qareeb — Jamal aur Abbas ne top par rakha

pakistan.summary: Defending champions Pakistan Shaheens aaj Doha mein ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 mein UAE ke khilaf apna campaign shuru kar rahe hain — match subah 11 baje PKT. Abdul Samad ki qiyadat mein 15-member squad mein Hasan Nawaz, Mohammad Hasnain aur Sufyan Muqeem shamil hain. Group B mein India A (22 Nov) aur Nepal (24 Nov) se bhi muqabla hai — final 29 Nov ko.
pakistan.title: Shaheens ka Rising Stars Asia Cup title defence aaj UAE ke khilaf shuru

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne T20 Asia Cup of the Blind ke semi-final mein defending champions India ko aakhri ball par 1 wicket se hara kar final mein jagah bana li — 180 ka target, aakhri 2 balls par 7 runs chahiye the, aur Niamatullah ne chhakka phir chauka laga kar match khatam kiya. Captain Nisar Ali ne 64 runs banaye aur Player of the Match rahe. Final aaj Dhaka mein hai — muqabla India-Bangladesh match ke winner se.
pakistan.title: Blind Cricket Asia Cup final aaj — Pakistan ne India ko last ball par hara kar final mein jagah banai
